label: typo-or-wording-in-added-text
name: Misspelling, run-together words, wrong identifier or over-wide line in added comments, strings and docs
description: What breaks: an added comment, assert or log string, Markdown line or heading contains a non-word (specifiedlocation, flgiht, wiorker, cosntants, goign, annd), a sentence starting lowercase, a heading cased unlike its siblings, an identifier-shaped token that matches no symbol (LOG_TOKEN_TIMS 3125494616), or a Markdown line far wider than the file's wrap width (144 and 130 columns in files wrapped near 90: 3778051701, 3778058064). Wade almost always answers with a ```suggestion block carrying the corrected line and no prose (17 of 19 rows); five consecutive one-line fixes on one file (3307296300, 3307297422, 3307298245, 3307366165, 3307465363). He fixes pre-existing typos that re-indentation puts in the diff (3307465363). Procedure: take every added line that is a comment, string literal or .md text; strip code identifiers and backticked spans; spell-check the rest; for UPPER_CASE or snake_case tokens inside comments grep the repository for the symbol; compare heading case within the file; compare .md line width against the file's median. Emit one suggestion block per line.
disposition_reason: No existing check reads added prose for spelling; 19 rows over 8 PRs, fully mechanical.
agent_feasibility: yes: spell-check of added comment/string/doc lines plus a symbol grep for identifier-shaped tokens.

detection.procedure: For each changed .md file, compute the max line length of added lines versus the median of unchanged lines (awk over the diff).
